dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What have you been up to lately?

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: Pic—pic—pic—pic—picking up trash. Sor—sor—sor—sor—sorting out garbage.

dialogues.speaker: Chard Lombro
dialogues.text: They call this "waste separation," but why does it need to be separated? This waste was fine where it was.
